description: The chart consists of three pie charts representing the distribution of difficulty levels in knowledge crosswords for large language models. The first pie chart, labeled "easy," shows three categories: N+K+ with 55.4%, N-K- with 38.3%, and N+K- with 1.7%. The second pie chart, labeled "medium," also has three categories: N+K+ with 58.8%, N-K- with 35.4%, and N+K- with 1.8%. The third pie chart, labeled "hard," displays four categories: N+K+ with 37.3%, N-K+ with 37.9%, N-K- with 6.7%, and N+K- with 6.7%. Each pie chart has a legend indicating the color coding for the categories, and the percentages are labeled inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
